title: The Connected Domination Number and Some Hamiltonian Properties of Graphs
content: Let $G = (V, E)$ be a graph. A connected dominating set of $G$ is a subset of $V$ that is a dominating set and induces a connected subgraph of $G$.The connected domination number of $G$ is the minimum size of all connected dominating sets of $G$.In this note, we present sufficient conditions based on the connected domination number for some Hamiltonian properties of graphs.
